target.title: fix(venice): model list shows current live context limits
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users listing Venice models would see stale context-window limits for models already present in OpenClaw's static catalog after Venice changed those limits.

## Why This Change Was Made

Known Venice catalog models now use a valid `availableContextTokens` value from the same live `/api/v1/models` response already used for model discovery. If Venice omits the field, OpenClaw keeps the static fallback; retained output limits are bounded to the live context window.

The change does not alter authentication, discovery endpoints, retry/cache behavior, model capabilities, defaults, pricing, configuration, or other providers.

## User Impact

`openclaw models list --provider venice` and its `--all` view now show Venice's current context limits instead of stale bundled values, so model selection and displayed capacity match the provider catalog.

## Evidence

- Third-party contract: Venice documents `availableContextTokens` on its official models endpoint: https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/models/list
- Live provider response on 2026-07-19: `https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/models` returned HTTP 200 with 101 models. It reported `qwen3-vl-235b-a22b=128000`, `olafangensan-glm-4.7-flash-heretic=200000`, and control `qwen3-5-35b-a3b=256000`.
- Live OpenClaw before: both the default and `--all` Venice list views returned all 101 live rows, but showed `256000`, `128000`, and `256000` respectively.
- Live OpenClaw after: after normal isolated `openclaw onboard`, both list views returned all 101 live rows and showed `128000`, `200000`, and `256000` respectively.
- The live proof used a test-only placeholder credential because the models endpoint is public. No response was mocked or rewritten.
- Regression: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/venice/models.test.ts` (13 passed).
- Extension suite: `pnpm test:extension venice` (4 files, 22 passed).
- Repository changed-file gate: `OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 pnpm check:changed` (passed).
